payload.comment: Ingestion stage is structurally sound. Split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) match the official PathMNIST manifest exactly, no subsampling was applied, and all integrity hashes (archive MD5, per-split index SHA-256, code SHA-256) are present. The test-domain provenance note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K, different clinical center) is correctly documented. Package versions and platform details are fully recorded. One reproducibility gap: llm_model_digest is null while the run declares llm_model='qwen3.8' via ollama. Without a pinned digest or content hash, the exact model weights used cannot be independently verified, which weakens end-to-end reproducibility of any LLM-assisted pipeline steps. This does not block the ingestion stage itself, but should be resolved (or explicitly justified) before downstream stages that depend on LLM outputs are considered reproducible. No deterministic findings were raised. Proceeding to the next stage is appropriate.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null for model 'qwen3.8' (ollama); exact model weights are not pinned, limiting reproducibility of any LLM-dependent steps
Test set originates from a different clinical center (CRC-VAL-HE-7K); domain shift is documented but should be carried forward as a caveat in all downstream evaluation reporting
